raw_description:
Quickly see which expense-related emails have already been processed by Expense Agent, helping you distinguish processed from unprocessed messages with confidence. Expense Agent adds a **Processed by Expense Agent **tag in Outlook after a relevant email has been successfully processed.

Benefits
• Automatically marks successfully processed expense-related emails.
• Provides a clear processing-status indicator in Outlook, reducing the need to verify status manually.
• Makes it easier to distinguish processed from unprocessed expense-related emails.
title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Use tags to mark processed emails
